svg.desc: UML preview. Open the companion draw.io file to edit classes and connections.

text.tspan: Yodaphone.Web — production types, selected members and actual dependency injection relationships.
+ AddMessageAsync(id: string, role: MessageRole, content: string, CT): Task<ChatMessage>
+ SendMessageAsync(id: string, content: string, CT): Task<ChatMessage>
Implements all IChatService operations; serializes changes within this scoped service
+ GetAsync(id: Guid, userId: int, CT): Task<Conversation?>
Implements repository operations; maps domain objects to Data.Entities and back.
Validates history; replaces blocked responses with a fixed explanation.
Extends System.Exception; safe public error text.
The Blazor Chat page injects IChatService.
Program.Main registers scoped services and chooses OfflineChatAgent or CopilotFallbackChatAgent from Chat:Agent.
+ public − private # protected ~ internal / derived «…» stereotype
CT = CancellationToken; method default values and most constructors are omitted. Selected members are shown.
Dashed open arrow = dependency (including «tests»); dashed hollow triangle = interface realization; solid hollow triangle = inheritance.
Solid line = association; filled diamond = composition. Multiplicities are shown beside association ends.
